I do notice that it gets tangles out more easily than my old brush, and so far, there seems to be less hair being pulled out which is a plus.  The brush comes with a nice smaller version of itself to take on the go. I haven’t used the comb so I can’t comment about that, but it seems sturdy. reviews.x: Iactually bought it for brushing my sheep rugs, So far it works great. Especially like the red cleaning rod, it helps a lot :)

reviews.x: With a wife and two daughters in the house there's been a real struggle to find something they could use for their long hair.  Our 12 year old has the longest hair and getting that brushed each day is just a battle.  I'm not going to say these brushes solved all our problems, but our 12 year old said this was the best brush she'd ever used and that it made her hair shiny - and the wife agreed.  Your mileage may vary and all that, but for us this has been a five star product.  Did what it promise

This gift set is great because it has a small travel brush as well as a cleaning tool and comb. I haven't used the comb but the travel brush came in really handy as I usually only with my regular comb and no brush because the brush takes up too much space. Very sad because he was a puppy. His owners never took care of him properly. My neighbor on the other side of us was wanting to adopt him and she sobbed over his body. Nobody should die like this. I am sorry to write my review like this but the truth needed to be told.

Does a good job of detangling, distributing oil, and giving a little volume. I've used it a couple times a day for a couple months and no bristle breakage or anything yet. I really just wanted the big brush, but have been surprised how much I like having the little brush too, to throw in the glove compartment or a bag or whatever. Love that neither of them are covered with branding, unlike those offered from other sellers.

reviews.t: Definitely works to help with the frizz!
reviews.x: I have always wanted a brush like this wondering if it truly did help with frizz/flyways and this brush has made me a believer. Definitely works! The wood handle makes it an even more luxurious experience. Thanks to the multiple brushes I can store them in a different places to assure I have great looking hair all the time.  I would definitely recommend these brushes to anyone considering them!

reviews.t: Perfect for those who love large brushes
reviews.x: I have been looking for a large brush for a while now and once I saw this one bought it right away and don’t regret. Make no mistake: it is big and pretty heavy but this is works the best for my fuzzy hair. Also, it has a small brush for you to carry around so size and weight are not an issue. Haven’t tried the comb yet, don’t think I will using it too much but looks good as well.

reviews.t: Just as Good if not better than a wet brush !!
reviews.x: I purchased this set for my 8 yr old who has long curl hair somewhat thick but she is very tender headed ! Last night doing bed time stuff and she said mom did you brush my hair ? Usually she isn’t reminding me cause she hates her hair brushed !! But I asked her to rate it on pulling she said 10 but good !! I will be keeping these brushes !!

Great set of brushes in pretty good quality. I have one similar brush which is getting old and wanted to add one more in rotation. This set is ideal to have one at home, throw some in bag to take with you . I have thin hair which gets tangled a lot, using this brushes got my hair more silkier, shinier and less tangles.

reviews.t: Excellent product. Great value for the money!
reviews.x: I was surprised by how good this product is. It is very sturdy and easy to use. At first I was afraid it wouldn’t comb my head properly because I have thick long hair, but it did a very good job at gripping it despite the thickness. The best part is that it is very affordable.

This 4-piece set includes a selection this is quite versatile. The items are classically designed. The quantity of items makes this set very budget-friendly. The items are well-made and sturdy.  I would not hesitate to make an additional order from this seller in the future.

So much smoother than using the typical hair brush. It brushes through knots without ripping and causing massive pain and makes my hair feel extra shiny and smooth. I love that it came with a tiny brush too. It’s perfect for styling small chunks of hair or using on my bangs.

I have long moderately straight hair that tangles easily. My grandaughter has long curly hair... EVERYONE who has used my hairbrush remarks it is amazing. I think i have ordered at least 5 of these. Ive tried others but the butterfly is the best! Just ask the grand :)

i purchased this brush for my fiance. she has thick asian hair and has had trouble finding a brush suitable for her type of hair. after many years of searching,  i stumbled upon this brush and now she cant go anywhere without it. I think this beats a ring!

I have very thick hair that is naturally curly and falls below my waist.I love them!Seems to get through my hair better and doesn’t pull as hard. I do get a few tangles but not nearly as many as I have with other brushes.

I have very long (down to my butt), very thick, wavy hair that tangles easily. This brush is awesome. It brushes right through the tangles with ease and the boar bristles leave my hair shiney and smooth.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the set's ability to detangle hair smoothly and without pain, including for children with curly or easily tangled hair.
Many reviewers highlight the value of the multi-piece set, especially the small travel brush and the cleaning tool for removing hair from the brush.
Several reviewers say the brush works well for thick, curly, or fuzzy hair and grips it effectively.
Some reviewers note the bristles are coarse, thick, and hard, which suits thick hair but may not suit everyone.
A few reviewers mention benefits like reduced frizz, shinier hair, and less hair pulled out.
